cat > /tmp/bench4.py <<'EOF'
import time, random, resource
V = 262144
random.seed(0)
def rss(): return resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024.0
print("baseline rss MB", rss())
# variant A: list of 3-tuples per phase (P=512 phases, 2048 edges each)
P=512
t0=time.time()
A=[]
for p in range(P):
    lst=[]
    for k in range(2048):
        lst.append((random.randrange(V), random.randint(0,10**12), random.randint(0,10)))
    A.append(lst)
print("A tuples-of-3: build %.2fs rss %.0f MB"%(time.time()-t0, rss()))
EOF
python3 /tmp/bench4.py
cat > /tmp/bench5.py <<'EOF'
import time, random, resource
V = 262144
def rss(): return resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024.0
P=512
random.seed(0)
t0=time.time()
B=[]
for p in range(P):
    dests=[random.randrange(V) for _ in range(2048)]
    keys=[random.randint(0,10**12) for _ in range(2048)]
    gcs=[random.randint(0,10) for _ in range(2048)]
    B.append((dests,keys,gcs))
print("B 3 flat lists: build %.2fs rss %.0f MB"%(time.time()-t0, rss()))
EOF

import time, random, resource
V = 262144
def rss(): return resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024.0
P=512
random.seed(0)
t0=time.time()
C=[]
for p in range(P):
    lst=[]
    for k in range(2048):
        gc=random.randint(0,10)
        lst.append((gc*V+random.randrange(V), random.randint(0,10**12)))
